name: Band Face Pull
instructions: Anchor a resistance band at face height, stand facing it, and hold the ends with your arms extended.
Pull the band toward your face, splitting your hands apart and driving your elbows back and out.
Pause with your shoulder blades squeezed, then return slowly.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.
image_prompt_scene: Standing with a band anchored at face height and the arms extended.
